author: Unity
description:
Learn about the clean, event-driven C# architecture that powers the Industry Fundamentals template. This tutorial provides a comprehensive look at how ScriptableObjects are used as a centralized, decoupled data layer, keeping the UI and core logic separate and maintainable.

Topics covered:
✅ Understanding the event-driven codebase
✅ Implementing the decoupled data architecture using ScriptableObjects
✅ Best practices for creating scalable and flexible industrial application code

The Industry Fundamentals template is built using Unity 6.4, with Windows as the recommended platform for use.

Get access to the Industry Fundamentals template:
If you are a Unity Industry subscriber: Open the Unity Hub, create a new project, and search for Industry Fundamentals or go to the Learning category for templates using Unity 6.4.

title: Industry Fundamentals: C# architecture and ScriptableObjects

author: Unity
description:
The Industry Fundamentals template is an in-Editor tutorial that demonstrates the complete workflow for creating an interactive industrial simulation. It starts with the steps for preparing and optimizing raw 3D data with the Unity Asset Transformer Toolkit to be used as 3D assets in the Unity Editor. It then shows how the fully-functional demo scene is set up with scripts, UI Toolkit, the NavMesh system, the Cinemachine virtual camera system, and more. 

This first video provides a high-level walkthrough of the entire project, its core features, and the results you'll achieve by the end of the series.

Topics covered:
✅ High-level overview of the Asset Transformer Toolkit (ATT) workflow
✅ Preview of the final interactive warehouse scene and its capabilities
✅ Introduction to the four main stages: Import, optimize, automate, and finalize

The Industry Fundamentals template is built using Unity 6.4, with Windows as the recommended platform for use.
